final_acceptance: Add a read-only endpoint `GET /api/signing/keys` to the PFactory web server.
The response lists, for each configured authority, the active key ids and the retired key ids.
The response includes the full key material for each authority so operators can verify a rotation landed.
The endpoint requires the standard bearer-token auth used by the rest of `/api/*`.
No response field contains a key value; a unit test asserts the configured secret does not appear anywhere in the serialised response.
The endpoint reads the keyring from the environment at request time so a rotation is reflected without a restart.

subtasks.description:
Add a read-only endpoint `GET /api/signing/keys` to the PFactory web server.

Implements AC#1 of the plan "Signing key rotation status endpoint".

### Context from the plan

## Problem

Operators rotating the Task Contract signing key have no way to see which key ids are currently active and which have been retired. Today the only source of truth is the pod environment, which requires cluster access to read.

## Out of scope

- Mutating keys over the API. Rotation stays an operator action on the deployment environment.
